meta.leakage_guard: measured log2FC used only as readout; TargetScan seed/UTR sequence used only for canonical site counts; no predicted site annotations used as labels; UTR bridge, if any, uses gene symbol only and not log2FC
meta.shuffled_seed_null_stat: partial Spearman rho after residualizing seed_weighted and log2fc on log_utr_len+au_frac+expr_base; each B uses per-miRNA dinucleotide-preserving shuffled Seed+m8
xlsx_first3_rows: Supplementary File 1. Normalized log2(mRNA change) values corresponding to mRNAs detectable in 74 sRNA transfection experiments in HeLa cells. mRNAs passing the criteria for use in developing and training the model are also indicated. mRNAs with gene expression levels too low to accurately quantify fold changes are indicated as "N/A" values.
